gaps: G1: import edges mislabeled reference_qualified (the tier classifier hardcodes reference_qualified for references, ignoring isImportDep — the JVM-family finding from java's pass) AND the edge source stays the 'root' placeholder (kotlin rewrites to the file's primary type; scala does not — family inconsistency)
G2: pattern type references lost — case p: Point, case Point(a, b), case s: String emit NO reference to Point/String
G3: Foo.bar method values emit no reference to Foo (the callable-reference analog of kotlin K3)
G4: string interpolation s"hi $name" emits no Uses on name (kotlin K4 analog)

G5: tuple-typed returns (Int, String) emit no type references (the return-type collector only matches generic_type/type_identifier/functional_type — tuple_type and compound/structural types are missed)
G6: derives Show, Hashing emits no references to the derived types
G7: type alias RHS references lost — type Fn = (Int) => String emits the Fn symbol (works) but NO references to Int/String from the alias's own definition
G8: field accesses h.value (reads AND writes) emit no Uses on the receiver — scala has no field-access uses collector (only extension methods emit Uses); family gap vs java/groovy/kotlin
G9: self-type references lost — trait Logging { self: Service => } emits no reference to Service
